# Certain positive ground with open forms in visible futures

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`positive-ground-open-futures` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F07 · [record](positive-ground-open-futures.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Where each admitted continuation realizes living content absent before, living significance gives each some relevant content absent before, which may differ between continuations; in a two-branch model one response realizes a fresh claim in each branch and none in both.

<details><summary>README overview</summary>

**Significance, comparison and practical judgment**

**Living significance: every living claim has significance from every standpoint; on a frame, realized living content falls under the relevance read from significance.** It gives significance, not a positive valence, and the readings of `living` do not include further generation; 生生, the continuation of life, is read separately (D1). The "positive" of this result's positive ground is the relevance parameter of living significance, not a valence that living significance supplies. Humans and AI are differentiated formations within that relational unfolding. With warranted generative correspondence and an explicit practical articulation, generative contributions supply reasons applicable to any agent so situated, independently of its culture, identity or endorsement. A single response can secure **some generative good in every supported visible continuation while leaving its particular future form open**. Real generative possibilities and further evidence revision can both remain available. This positive conclusion requires neither a complete future integral nor proof that the whole becomes strictly better.

**Evidence:** **Living significance is not an adopted axiom, nor a theorem proved outright:** the theory without the condition states it as a condition, and under the continuation condition it is a theorem (chapter 7, its section on the continuation condition; the theory does not assert the condition); the chapter on its warrant sets out the support for its content. Lean checks what follows from it and, in one supplied law class, a dynamical distinction that an event-by-event broad reading does not draw; identifying that distinction with 生生 is a reading and correspondence question, not a Lean result. Premise footprint: the positive conclusion needs only living significance and actual correspondence, not whole improvement, a complete ranking or a future integral; one response secures some new generation in every visible branch without fixing its form, and new evidence can retract the certificate (independently reviewed). Every position with access has the reason whatever its endorsement, an independence supplied by the practical articulation rather than by living significance. Under a supplied no-recovery wear law (dynamics with no normative predicate): formation within renewal never ceases, whereas formation that persistently exceeds renewal, wearing the renewing organization it depends on, has a bounded total, ceases by an explicit time and ends co-dependent formation, although it forms more at first. A contributory reason is not by itself final permission.

</details>

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- Living significance (LivingSignificance) is an explicit normative premise; actual new living relations, the same response and the admitted continuations require correspondence. The theorem uses no C, global no-loss premise or Better.
- Positive content supplies a contributory reason through an explicit direct practical articulation; it gives neither final permission, duty nor a uniquely optimal action.
- The optional finite integral uses local units, addition, duplicate-free occurrence domains and positive-contribution correspondence to actual generative relations; it is neither a sum of privately owned utilities nor a universal ethical total.
- The construction supplies explicit response, branching and reading laws. Actual coverage is used for scope-to-actual guarantee, without requiring identification of the whole universe or infinite future.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Securing content in every admitted continuation is a sufficient ground for the reason, not a condition every exploration must meet.
- No strict improvement of the whole, global optimality, unconditional permission, integral over the full future or inevitable convergence of behaviour follows.
- A contributory reason is neither final permission nor a duty nor a uniquely optimal action.
- The certificate holds at the admitted scope; widening the scope to a barren possibility makes it fail. Witness: `Becoming.SecuredContent.wider_scope_can_require_certificate_retraction`.
- The query channel is a field the response keeps; no reading law inspects it, so no executed query channel is shown.
- Preserving every represented joint possibility says nothing of unrepresented losses, and the burden stays. Witness: `Becoming.SecuredContent.positive_integral_and_adverse_full_change`.
- **Counterexample:** No fixed new form occurs in every branch of a productive model; some new generation nevertheless occurs in each branch. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/universal-ethics/generative-capacity/PositiveGroundUncertainty.lean)
- **Counterexample:** The positive-aspect integral is positive while the full represented change including the same continuation's burden is −1. This retains positive ground without recommending the response or supplying universal ethical weights between gains and burdens. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/universal-ethics/generative-capacity/PositiveGroundUncertainty.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** States how significance relates to structure, for any significance or under the continuation condition (Unrestricted: the continuation of anything has significance); it asserts no significance and does not assert the condition.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

New content forms through prior activity, a productive relation and the common response in one unfolding. Each fixed productive model admits two real future branches; two surviving magnitude models separately represent epistemic uncertainty. Evidence filtering does not perform the response, so increased recognition is not new life. Existing formed perception, prediction and inquiry results ground visible futures interpretively; apart from the explicitly compiled truth-retention and scope-transfer examples, no new full same-history mechanism composition is asserted.
